title: Introducing Basedash for Excel
summary: Basedash now works with Excel, both ways. Drop an .xlsx file into the agent and it reads, analyzes, and builds charts and dashboards from your data — and…
body_markdown:
Today we’re launching **Basedash for Excel** , the fastest way to turn a spreadsheet into a live dashboard and to get your dashboard data back into Excel when you need it.


Drop an` .xlsx` file into the Basedash agent and it reads your data, figures out what’s in it, and builds the charts and dashboards for you. When you want to keep working in spreadsheets, export any chart’s data straight back to a` .xlsx` file.


## Why we built it


Plenty of teams still live in Excel. It’s where the numbers start and where ad-hoc analysis happens. But once you want a proper dashboard, a second opinion on the data, or something live to share with the rest of the team, you hit the limits of what a spreadsheet does well.


With Basedash for Excel, you don’t have to migrate anything or rebuild your data somewhere else. You hand the agent the file you already have, and it does the rest.


## Drop in a spreadsheet, get a dashboard


Attach an` .xlsx` file to the agent and ask for what you want: “turn this into a dashboard”, “what’s driving the Q2 jump?”, “break revenue down by month”.


The agent reads every row, infers your column types and totals, writes the queries, and builds the visualizations. You don’t need formulas, pivot tables, or any setup.


Because it’s the same[AI data analyst](https://www.basedash.com/features/ai-data-analyst) that powers the rest of Basedash, you can keep the conversation going: ask a follow-up, drill into a number, or pull in another file, and the dashboard updates with you.


## And export right back to Excel


The other direction matters as much. Any chart in Basedash can export its underlying data to a` .xlsx` file with one click, so you can move straight to a spreadsheet when that’s your next step.


Run the analysis in Basedash, hand the numbers back to whoever needs them in Excel, and everyone keeps working in the tool they prefer.


## How it works


Under the hood, it’s the same analyst that explores your schema, writes and verifies SQL, and uses your custom business context, now pointed at the spreadsheet you uploaded. Your Excel data becomes a queryable source as soon as you upload it.


## Excel and Basedash, both ways


For teams who live in Excel, this means an AI data analyst, live dashboards, and real-time collaboration on top of the files you already trust, without giving up the spreadsheet workflow you know.


## Getting started


Basedash for Excel is available today for all Basedash users:


1. [Sign up for Basedash](https://charts.basedash.com/signup) (or log in)
2. Attach an` .xlsx` file to the agent and ask it to analyze or chart your data
3. Build out a dashboard, then export any chart’s data back to Excel whenever you need it


## What’s next


Your spreadsheets already hold the data, and now you can turn them into dashboards.


Try Basedash for Excel today.
